description: Exact return shape of SigData.genSound(n) in assets/engine.js. Every field is always present on archive records (JAH-SOUND-%07d). Subtype cycles deterministically: LIB_SUBTYPES[n % 4].

desc.description: Varies by subtype: sound -> brightness/warmth/attack + '.wav preview' note; instrument -> velocity response + octave range; set -> sound count + mix character; pack -> sound/loop/one-shot count, mix-ready.

id.description: Permanent ID. Never reused. Reproducible seed is n.

n.description: Deterministic seed. genSound uses rngFrom('soundrec:' + n).

voice.description: Synth voice engine code: SOUND_TYPES base[2]. Drives SigSynth.tone / the studio extension's custom() mapping.

title: Signature Music Studio — Sound-library record
